notes: grade 4 astrocytoma histopathologies. Counts not published in the accessible text; only the percentage. Our Mut definition adds GBM IDH-mutant (9445/3) which Fig 4 already counts within grade-4 astrocytoma.

mean of grade 2 (55.3%) and grade 3 (50.7%) astrocytoma. ASTROCYTOMA ONLY: oligodendroglioma is excluded from this figure and is IDH-mutant by definition, so this UNDERSTATES pi for our label definition. Magnitude of the gap is not derivable from the accessible tables - see the sensitivity row.

SENSITIVITY ONLY - NOT A SOURCE VALUE. Assumes oligodendroglioma is ~25% of grade 2-3 diffuse glioma and all IDH-mutant: 0.530*0.75+0.25. The grade split of the 7606 IDH-mutant astrocytoma and 4785 oligodendroglioma cases in Table 3 is not published in the accessible text, so the true value cannot be computed.

marginal over all adult-type diffuse glioma: (7606 IDH-mut astrocytoma + 4785 IDH-mut 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma) / (7606 + 4785 + 56123 IDH-wildtype astrocytoma/glioblastoma) = 0.181. Fallback for a form answer of 'unknown'.
